name: Alprostadil
description: Drug form of prostaglandin E1, a natural fatty-acid messenger; for ED, injected into the penis

note.text: Compounded Trimix mixes alprostadil with papaverine and phentolamine. In one trial it caused more priapism than alprostadil alone.

bullets: **Binds its receptors** in the penis and raises cAMP (label)
**Relaxes spongy smooth muscle** and widens penile arteries
**Filled spaces press** the small veins shut, trapping blood

practical.routes: Injection into the penis; urethral pellet (now discontinued)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Main metabolite peaks at 30 minutes, back to baseline by 60
practical.monitored: Penile exam for scarring, erections over 4 hours, blood pressure

references: Linet and Ogrinc, N Engl J Med, intracavernosal alprostadil, Apr 1996
Padma-Nathan et al., N Engl J Med, urethral alprostadil (Muse), Jan 1997
